title: Editor Backend Unavailable Honesty Review
summary: Recorded an Editor-owned honesty review and narrow Shell fix so fixture-backed Preview fallback does not hide Backend-unavailable context state behind migration-required copy.
expectedOutput: Editor-owned evidence or implementation that distinguishes fixture fallback, partial reads, unsupported versions, and loaded backend documents in product-facing UI.
riskSummary: The Editor still permits direct document routes to keep fixture content visible when Backend is unavailable; this lane fixes Preview status honesty but does not define the final production document-read fallback policy.
